To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have found a new type of string theory, which we have called a moose string, and that it is dual to the DLCQ of a pp-wave string background.

• We considered N = 2 supersymmetric moose/quiver theories corresponding to N D3-branes at C / Z N2 singularity, and in the “large-moose” limit where both N and N2 are sent to infinity, we identified the string operators that describe the DLCQ of the string in the corresponding holographically dual pp-wave background.
• The large N1, N2 quiver gauge theory is a non-relativistic string theory with a discrete spectrum of excitations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the AdS/CFT correspondence and its applications to gauge/gravity duality and string theory.
understanding how the string theory dual to the large N gauge theory is realized in the large moose/quive diagram.
the study of the AdS5/CFT4 correspondence and its generalizations.

the string theory of N=2 moose/quivers is a non-relativistic type IIB string in the background of a non-relativisitic pp-wave.
the gauge theory is not a good description of the string, but rather a description of the DLCQ of the string, and in particular of its ground state.
the gauge theory is a good holographic model for the pp-wave string theory.
